action_future_interface.actions: up to 40x8 returned; first 8 executed per request

caption_exposure.audit_method: No training-caption corpus or episode-to-caption manifest is committed. Checkpoint names and this study's inference prompts are not treated as training-caption evidence.

preprocessing.action: Checkpoint may return 40x8; the registered execution horizon is eight actions.

source_boundary: Training-data, caption, and training-preprocessing claims stop at public/committed disclosure. Observed inference adapters do not establish how the checkpoint was trained.

datasets.source_boundary: target-domain label; not a training-episode audit
